title: smime-tree: certificate chain validation (cert.rs)
description:
verify() needs to validate a signer's cert chain against caller-provided trust anchors. No network (no OCSP, no CRL fetch). RFC 5280 at ~/PROJECT/MIME/standards/rfc5280.txt.

Do NOT hand-roll certificate signature verification or chain building. Research first:
- x509-cert 0.2.x has CertificatePathBuilder — evaluate if it performs full PKIX validation including signature checks up the chain
- webpki / rustls-webpki as alternative if x509-cert path building is insufficient
- Choose whichever crate provides actual cryptographic chain validation, not just structural chain building

What must work: given a SignedData.certificates bag plus caller-supplied trust anchors, verify that the signer cert chains to a trust anchor with valid signatures and validity periods at each step.
acceptance_criteria: validate_chain() accepts a known-good chain and rejects an untrusted cert; tested with OpenSSL-generated cert chains
